title: Stir-Fried Noodles with Crispy Dark Chocolate
description: A sweet and savory twist on traditional Chinese stir-fries, featuring crispy dark chocolate and crunchy rye.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the rye bread crumbs and cook, stirring frequently, until crispy and golden brown.
Remove the crumbs from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet and cook the dark chocolate chips until melted and fragrant.
Add the malaysian noodles to the skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
Return the crispy rye bread crumbs to the skillet and stir-fry for an additional minute.
Season with soy sauce to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional crispy rye bread crumbs if desired.
